select t2.pbc_code from chb_prd_deal deal LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=deal.PROD_ID where deal.TRADE_TYPE='16' and deal.STATUS in ('E','M') and DATE_FORMAT(deal.SETTDATE_DATE,'%Y%m') = #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT IFNULL(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as PBC_PROD_ID FROM pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID where a.OPERATE_MODE ='3' and DATE_FORMAT(a.VDATE,'%Y%m') != #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT IFNULL(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as PBC_PROD_ID FROM pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID where a.OPERATE_MODE ='3' AND a.CUS_REDEEM_FLAG='2' and not exists( select 1 from pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_end_sub b where a.PBC_PROD_ID=b.PBC_PROD_ID and DATE_FORMAT(b.MDATE,'%Y%m') != #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT IFNULL(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as PBC_PROD_ID FROM pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID where 1=1 and exists( select 1 from pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_end_sub b where a.PBC_PROD_ID=b.PBC_PROD_ID and DATE_FORMAT(b.MDATE,'%Y%m') = #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select DISTINCT ifnull(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as PBC_PROD_ID from pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a left join pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_end_sub b on a.PBC_PROD_ID = b.PBC_PROD_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID where DATE_FORMAT(a.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') < #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and b.REGIST_SEQNO is null
